title: The a-Pawn Must Take
setup: Black's king sits in the corner behind its own rook and pawns, and the a-file is the only way in.
hint: The king has no legal move at all. Find the check whose only answer opens the file you want.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nb6+}} can be answered in exactly one way, {{axb6}}. The a-pawn is dragged off the a-file, and {{Ra1#}} runs straight down the open road. Give anything to a defender that has no choice.
